decisions.reason: As a mature German metal-products firm, we would keep this black-finish range because it is a low-risk aesthetic extension of our core drainage know-how and its continued standalone presentation suggests acceptable market uptake.

We would keep this shower channel because seamless-bathroom drainage is still close to our established technical base, and two years of website presence indicate enough learning and demand to justify further commercial refinement.

We would keep this newer pump-drain channel for now because it builds on knowledge gained from the earlier pump-assisted attempt, but its greater technical complexity and recent launch make it the most likely of the three to be discontinued if market feedback stays weak.
